scientific_question: Are four-dataset downstream results attributable to PAFA ICBHI task training or to generic AudioSet BEATs representations?

r0_pafa_icbhi_task_encoder.initialization: PAFA ICBHI task checkpoint accepted epoch 27

r2_beats_random_init_sanity.initialization: same BEATs architecture/config as R1; random tensors

fixed_downstream.condition: D2 shared 768->256 adapter plus six native heads
fixed_downstream.selection: unweighted mean validation macro-F1 across six native heads
fixed_downstream.folds: five KAUH-fold-conditioned models; KAUH aggregate patient OOF
fixed_downstream.test_policy: outer/test used only after validation selection; SPR inter prediction is label-free before terminal join

preregistered_attribution_rule.close: absolute R1-R0 primary and secondary gaps are both <=0.02
preregistered_attribution_rule.stability_margin: sample standard deviation difference <=0.01 is treated as practically similar
preregistered_attribution_rule.pafa_selection_gate: select R0 only if R0 has a material task win on ICBHI and at least one additional native task, has no more material task losses than wins across six tasks, and is not less stable by >0.01 on more than one non-KAUH task
preregistered_attribution_rule.neutral_default: otherwise select R1 AudioSet-only for Step 2
preregistered_attribution_rule.random_rule: R2 is never eligible for encoder selection
preregistered_attribution_rule.forbidden: no pooled raw Score, no pooled metric average, no test-side threshold/epoch/representation selection beyond this frozen task-wise rule

claim_boundary: R2 is a random-feature floor, not a training baseline
